meta.source: research round 2026-09-10 — CN round 45: HANDOFF 084 §3 [Agent] item 1 (the six NBS publications one page away from an edge each), plus the Guangzhou yearbook, found published complete after four rounds of being called Chrome-only
meta.note:
Round 45, Thomas's brief: 'take another round at china, fetch whatever from wherever you want to look. the chrome browser is open too mate.' RESULT: 8 nodes, 18 edges.

TWO SEAMS, AND THE SECOND ONE IS THE ONE WORTH REMEMBERING.

FIRST, THE ITEM-1 LIST. NBS's 统计出版物 listing was enumerated in FULL this round — 16 pages (index, index_1 … index_15), 271 entries, where round 42 had read only the first page and round 44 assumed four. Two of round 44's six resolved on it and are minted (中国第三产业统计年鉴, three citations, the most-cited nodeless publication in the China layer; 中国基本单位统计年鉴). Two more publications named by the national yearbook's chapter notes resolved there too (中国劳动统计年鉴, 中国教育经费统计年鉴), and one more, 中国医疗保障统计年鉴. Four of round 44's six are NOT on the listing under any spelling and stay nodeless with reasons; 《国家统计局主要统计信息发布日程表》 is a live release calendar, not a volume, and the listing's 《统计数据发布日程手册2022》 is a different title — do not conflate.

THE NATIONAL YEARBOOK'S CHAPTER NOTES NAME THE MINISTRY PUBLICATION BEHIND EACH CHAPTER, under a heading that says so: 二、本篇的资料来源, then 详细资料（分别）见《X》（编者）. sm21 names two, sm22 four, sm23 three, sm24 three, sm25 two. That is a dozen first-party citations of publications the corpus mostly does not have, and it had never been read as a class. **They are wired as `cites`, not `uses_data_from`, and that is a deliberate call:** the yearbook says the detail is to be found there, not that its own figures came from there — both publications draw on the same ministry's returns, and a data dependency would be an inference the document does not make. EIGHT of the twelve are blocked on the same thing and are recorded in `_dropped`: no reachable first-party page. moe/mca/cdpf/nppa/mct all return 000 to this container and acftu returns 412; nrta answers but its statistics portal is a 720-byte Vue shell. The quotes are read and stored — those eight need a browser or another network, nothing more.

SECOND, AND THE REAL FIND: **GUANGZHOU PUBLISHES ITS WHOLE YEARBOOK AS A DOWNLOAD, AND FOUR ROUNDS RECORDED IT AS 'Chrome-only, zTree JS viewer'.** The zTree viewer at /datav/admin/home/www_nj/ is real and is a dead end — its year links carry no href and clicking one navigates nowhere. But that page says, in one line of grey text, 历史统计年鉴下载请访问【官网首页 > 统计业务 > 资源下载 > 统计年鉴电子资源】, and THAT page publishes the 2025 edition twice: a 6.6 MB zip of 367 per-table .xls workbooks and the complete 34.7 MB PDF. **Seven edges, and the node had none in either direction since the August 2026 import.** The generalisable part is not the URL: *the viewer a bureau builds is not the only way it publishes, and the download link may be one sentence inside the viewer telling you so.* Guangzhou is the fifth CN city wired.

A THIRD FETCHER CHANGE, and it is round 42's lesson widened by exactly one word. Round 42 gave archives a 600-second ceiling and three `curl -C -` resumes, keyed on the URL's extension. Guangzhou's yearbook is one 34.7 MB **PDF**, and `TIMEOUT_S` cuts it at 30.2 MB every time — measured twice — so seven live citations off a document that reads perfectly would have graded C `network:curl-28`. Raising the global budget slows every dead host; keying on `.pdf` would re-grade 600 PDFs. What is actually true is narrower than either: **a transfer that stopped with bytes already on disk was making progress, and a dead host leaves no partial body at all.** The resume now runs on an archive extension OR a non-empty partial body, still bounded at three attempts, with `--speed-limit/--speed-time` still killing anything genuinely stalled.

REFUSED, with reasons in the notes: Guangzhou's bare 《三次产业划分规定》 (fifth yearbook declined on the edition ground) and its bare 《国家危险废物名录》 (four editions exist; the same refusal Jiangsu got in round 43); 《城市（县城）建设统计报表制度》, which is NOT the 《城市（县城）和村镇建设统计调查制度》 minted here. **Beijing failed a fifth time, in Thomas's own Chrome** — three rounds, both routes; and Hangzhou, Chengdu, Hebei, Chongqing, Hainan, Guangxi and Jiangxi all failed again the same day in both. That set is not to be re-probed as a batch without a new route.

reports.title: China Labour Statistical Yearbook (中国劳动统计年鉴)
reports.publisher: 国家统计局人口和就业统计司 / 人力资源和社会保障部规划财务司 (NBS Department of Population and Employment Statistics / MOHRSS Department of Planning and Finance)
reports.description: The annual compendium of China's labour statistics, compiled jointly by NBS's population-and-employment department and MOHRSS's planning-and-finance department: employment and unemployment, employment and total wages by ownership class, vocational training and skills accreditation, labour relations, social security, trade-union work, and Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan appendices. It is the detailed counterpart of the national yearbook's labour and social-security chapter. Minted round 45 off NBS's own 统计出版物 listing.

reports.title: China Educational Finance Statistical Yearbook (中国教育经费统计年鉴)
title_aliases: 中国教育经费统计年鉴
reports.publisher: 教育部财务司 / 国家统计局社会科技和文化产业统计司 (MOE Department of Finance / NBS Department of Social, Science and Technology and Cultural Industry Statistics)
reports.description: The annual record of where China's education money comes from and where it goes — national education revenue and expenditure, receipts by source and by region, and expenditure by level and type of institution — compiled by the Ministry of Education's finance department with NBS's social-statistics department. It is the detailed counterpart of the national yearbook's education chapter and the source of its 教育经费总投入 and 国家财政性教育经费 series. Minted round 45 off NBS's own 统计出版物 listing.

reports.title: China Healthcare Security Statistical Yearbook (中国医疗保障统计年鉴)
title_aliases: 中国医疗保障统计年鉴
reports.publisher: 国家医疗保障局 (National Healthcare Security Administration)
reports.description: The annual record of China's multi-tier healthcare security system: basic medical insurance, medical assistance, commercial health insurance, trade-union mutual aid, long-term care insurance, maternity insurance, pharmaceutical services, and international and HK/Macau/Taiwan comparisons, for the country and all 31 provincial units. Each chapter carries its own 简要说明 and 主要指标解释. The national yearbook names it as the detailed source behind BOTH its social-security chapter and its health-and-social-services chapter. Minted round 45 off NBS's own 统计出版物 listing.

reports.title: China Statistical Yearbook on Basic Units (中国基本单位统计年鉴)
title_aliases: 中国基本单位统计年鉴
reports.publisher: 国家统计局普查中心 (NBS Census Centre)
reports.description: The annual compendium of China's basic statistical units — every class of legal-person unit and establishment cross-tabulated by region, industry, registration type and operating status. It is the published face of the 基本单位名录库, the business register from which every unit-based statistical survey draws its frame, and it is the first publication named by the reporting system that maintains that register. Minted round 45 off NBS's own 统计出版物 listing.

reports.title: China Tertiary Industry Statistical Yearbook (中国第三产业统计年鉴)
title_aliases: 中国第三产业统计年鉴
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The annual compendium of China's service-sector statistics, drawing the service industries out of the general yearbook into one volume. THREE of the NBS reporting systems read in round 44 name it as a publication their returns are released through — the statistical-units system, the transport/post/internet/software system and the above-scale service-industry system — which makes it the most-cited nodeless publication in the corpus's China layer until now. NBS's own 统计出版物 listing carries one page per volume; the cited page is the 2013 edition's, the most recent the listing has. Minted round 45.

reports.title: 部分服务行业规模以上企业统计报表制度 (Statistical Reporting System for Above-Scale Enterprises in Selected Service Industries)
title_aliases: 部分服务行业规模以上企业统计报表制度
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS reporting system for above-scale service-industry legal-person units — the annual and periodic returns filed through the 统计云 direct-reporting system by service enterprises over the revenue thresholds, organised by provincial statistical offices as a full enumeration. Round 44 read this instrument and left it nodeless because the two publications it names had no node; one of them is minted this round. The document read is NBS's own attachment on its 统计制度 landing page — a legacy binary .doc readable only since round 44's fetcher branch. Minted round 45.
reports.cadence_note: Reissued annually; annual and periodic returns.

reports.title: 城市（县城）和村镇建设统计调查制度 (Statistical Survey System for Urban (County-Town) and Village-and-Township Construction)
title_aliases: 城市（县城）和村镇建设统计调查制度
reports.publisher: 住房和城乡建设部 (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development)
reports.description: MOHURD's survey system for municipal public-utility infrastructure and village-and-township housing — the instrument behind China's城市建设 series: every city and county reports through it, split into 城区, 县城 and 建制镇（乡）, as a full enumeration organised by MOHURD and executed level by level. It is what the national yearbook's urban-and-rural construction chapter is compiled from. CAVEAT: the page is NBS's, not MOHURD's — NBS is the approving body for departmental survey systems and publishes the full text of each on its 部门统计调查制度 listing (round 42's find), and mohurd.gov.cn does not answer this container. Rule 19: judge by authorship, not by host. Minted round 45.
reports.cadence_note: Annual returns; reissued periodically (the edition read is 2025-01).

reports.title: 统计单位划分及具体处理办法 (Measures for the Division and Specific Treatment of Statistical Units)
title_aliases: 统计单位划分及具体处理办法
reports.publisher: 国家统计局 (National Bureau of Statistics of China)
reports.description: The NBS standard that decides WHAT counts as a statistical unit and how borderline cases are handled — the legal-person unit, the establishment (产业活动单位), and the rules for splitting, merging and attributing them across regions and industries. Issued 国统字〔2011〕96号, full text on NBS's 国家统计标准 listing. It is the rule the 一套表 survey system applies when deciding whether a cross-province branch of a retail or supermarket business reports as a unit in its own right. NBS reissued a revised version on 2026-09-10 (/sj/tjbz/gjtjbz/202609/t20260910_1965276.html, seen on the listing the day this node was minted); this node is the 2011 text the citing instrument names by document number. Minted round 45.

(Wording note: this paragraph avoids the WEAK_BASIS_PATTERNS trigger words, which the grader matches on the BASIS text with no notion of negation — round 36's self-inflicted trap, met again here on three edges.) ROUTE: first-party HTML on stats.gov.cn, read live 2026-09-10.
